name: Cross Stereo Mode with Small Room Simulation
description: Validates that echoform cross stereo ping-pong delay combines properly with small room acoustics. Tests cross-channel feedback + room reflections for enhanced spatial imaging.

capability_requirements.notes: Tests cross stereo + small room reflections

pingpong_output.description: Cross stereo + room should sustain ping-pong

stereo_separation.description: Cross routing + room should create distinct channels

spatial_width.description: Room should enhance ITD from cross routing

no_clipping.description: No clipping with cross + room processing

use_cases: Test ping-pong delay with spatial reflections
Ensure stable cross-feedback in spatial context
pass_criteria: Creates enhanced ping-pong effect with room reflections and strong spatial imaging
example_failures: High IACC → Cross routing not working with room (too correlated)
Low ITD → Room not enhancing spatial width
Unstable feedback → Cross + room interaction issue
